author: Frawg
notes_extra: 155 Berger VLD. His son's Remington 700. Used on deer for three years. The 30 cal 155 gr VLD is the hunting line.

author: Shortround
notes_extra: Remington 700 SPS Varmint. Half a grain under Hodgdon's max. The thread is 155 and 168 hunting bullets. The same day he said the hunting VLD penetrated about 4 inches and came unglued. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is .308.

author: KMart
notes_extra: 155 Hunting VLD. Remington ADL. About 0.003 jump. A 3-shot group of 0.3 at 100 yards.

author: k80skeet
notes_extra: 155gr VLD, also used with the 155.5 Fullbore. 0.040 off the lands.
